summary: Today the 15 stocks changed by an average of -0.3%, with 5 rising and 8 falling. Over 15–21 Sep the average change was -1.2%. The weakest sectors were Telecommunications (-2.9%), Financial Services (-2.6%) and Consumer Goods (-2.5%), while REIT (-0.4%) and Banking (-0.5%) performed best.

The biggest movers over 15–21 Sep were ComfortDelGro (-3.1%), Singtel (-2.9%) and SGX Group (-2.6%). ComfortDelGro’s change happened without a company news story, suggesting a sector-wide move. Singtel also moved more than the market without a company news story. For SGX Group, the company news and the price do not match.
The market backdrop is calm with VIX at 14.7. Singapore ETF options are leaning defensive, with a put/call ratio of 1.43, meaning more traders are buying protection against a fall.
Today’s news added a positive signal for SGX Group (not yet reflected in the price), UOB (already reflected), and Ascendas REIT (the price moved in the opposite direction).
Task 6 expects no big move for any of the 15 stocks. Typical 3-day swings range from ±1.0% at Mapletree Industrial to ±2.6% at SGX Group, so a move larger than a stock’s own swing would be unusual.

No stock is flagged today. ComfortDelGro and Singtel moved without company news, so look at sector or market news before reacting. If you want less day-to-day movement, Raffles Medical Group, Sembcorp Industries, Mapletree Pan Asia Comm. Trust, Keppel Corp and Mapletree Industrial have the highest chance of no big move.
